paragraphs.text: 1. THIS very mighty one whom Gods commission, the Conqueror of cars, ever triumphant,
paragraphs.original: त्यमू षु वाजिनं देवजूतं सहावानं तरुतारं रथानाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: tyamū ṣu vājinaṃ devajūtaṃ sahāvānaṃ tarutāraṃ rathānām |

paragraphs.text: Swift, fleet to battle, with uninjured fellies, even Tarksya for our weal will we call hither.
2. As though we offered up our gifts to Indra, may we ascend. him as a ship. for safety.
Like the two wide worlds, broad, deep far-extended, may we be safe both when he comes and leaves you.
paragraphs.original: उर्वी न पृथ्वी बहुले गभीरे मा वामेतौ मा परेतौ रिषाम
paragraphs.translit: urvī na pṛthvī bahule gabhīre mā vāmetau mā paretau riṣāma

paragraphs.text: 3. He who with might the Five Lands hath pervaded, like Surya with his lustre, and the waters-
paragraphs.original: सद्यश्चिद्यः शवसा पञ्च कृष्टीः सूर्य इव ज्योतिषापस्ततान ।
paragraphs.translit: sadyaścidyaḥ śavasā pañca kṛṣṭīḥ sūrya iva jyotiṣāpastatāna |

paragraphs.text: His strength wins hundreds, thousands none avert it, as the young maid repelleth not her lover.
paragraphs.original: सहस्रसाः शतसा अस्य रंहिर्न स्मा वरन्ते युवतिं न शर्याम्
paragraphs.translit: sahasrasāḥ śatasā asya raṃhirna smā varante yuvatiṃ na śaryām
